scene: Rushing through alleys, you bump along inside the rattling metal sidecar.
beats: You dial past crackling static into swinging jazz trumpet riffs just as the bike screeches into Midnight Radio Repair and its doors glide open.
You pop the wooden latch and pocket a humming vacuum tube right as the sidecar skids inside Midnight Radio Repair and the doors roll wide.
You tap the driver's leather shoulder; they nod and cut the engine as the sidecar glides into Midnight Radio Repair and its doors part.
picture: Side-view pixel scene inside the moving sidecar. On the far left sits a closed wooden glovebox. To its left, a small red radio glows. Centre, the player sits in the leather seat. On the right, the goggled driver steers the attached bike along the ground line.
shown: a crackling dashboard radio with glowing red dials on the left
a closed wooden glove compartment latched shut on the far left
the driver clad in goggles steering the connected motorbike on the right

after.label: Step off at Midnight Radio Repair
Stay on
after.beat: Zooming past the repair shop, you catch a drifting neon leaf before switching to the midnight funicular at the line's end. The glass car glides upward, docking right at Comet Watch Rooftop.
after.then: Step off at Comet Watch Rooftop
